summary: First frontend-only testing pass of ClinicalMind (cloned SuperClinic repo, Vite+React, no backend). App loads correctly at root URL, offline banner shown, and all major flows tested via Playwright: complaint library search/category filters, complaint card selection, patient age/sex inputs, Start Consultation gating, full offline BM25/decision-tree consultation flow (multi-question Q&A with red-flag banner + live differentials panel update), ComplaintEditor '+ New' modal (Details/Workflow/Clinical Content/Weights tabs) saving a private complaint that correctly appears under 'Private' tab, Document Vault .txt upload with chunk indexing, ProductToggle switching to SuperSummary (Template Library loads correctly) and back, ProfileMenu (Tag Library/Settings), and SettingsPanel provider selector + API key prefix validation (Save Key disabled for invalid prefix, enabled for valid 'sk-ant-' prefix). Confirmed via network request interception that NO calls hit /api or any backend (the only '/api' string match was the static /src/api.js module file, not a backend call) -- consistent with the bring-your-own-key, no-backend design. No console/page errors observed in any of the 6 test runs.

issues: No data-testid attributes anywhere in App.jsx or SuperSummary.jsx (grep returned 0 matches). All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, cards) rely on text content only, which made a few selectors ambiguous during automated testing (e.g. 'text=Respiratory' initially matched a hidden always-mounted Settings textarea instead of the category chip). Not a functional bug, but reduces testability/maintainability per best practices.

action_items: Optional: add data-testid attributes to key interactive elements (complaint cards, category chips, product toggle buttons, settings inputs, start consultation button) to improve automated testability -- purely a maintainability suggestion, not a functional bug.
No functional bugs found; app is working as designed for this bring-your-own-key, backend-less architecture.
critical_code_review_comments: App.jsx is very large (2460 lines) -- consider splitting into smaller component files (ComplaintEditor, DocumentVault, SettingsPanel, LibraryScreen etc. are all defined in this one file) for maintainability, though this doesn't block functionality.

SettingsPanel and other modal-style components appear to always be mounted in the DOM (just translated off-screen via CSS) even when closed, which caused their text (e.g. 'Settings', provider names) to appear in page.inner_text('body') results and initially confused text-based Playwright selectors -- this is a minor UX/testability quirk, not a bug.

success_rate.backend: N/A - no backend for this app by design

test_credentials: None required -- app fully functional offline without API keys, as intended.
seed_data_creation: Created one private complaint 'TEST Complaint XYZ' via UI (stored in browser localStorage of test session, not persistent server-side data) and uploaded a temporary /tmp/test_doc.txt for Document Vault testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All core flows (Library/search/filter, offline consultation with BM25+decision tree+red flags+differentials, ComplaintEditor create/save/private-tab, Document Vault upload/indexing, ProductToggle to SuperSummary and back, ProfileMenu, SettingsPanel with key validation) verified working with no console errors and no backend calls. Not yet tested in this pass: PDF upload/Open Reader/Parse for BM25 (.pdf specific flow), Tag Library modal deep interactions, OCR/vision fallback (requires API key, out of scope per instructions), and mobile/tablet responsive layouts. These could be covered in a follow-up pass if needed.
rca of the issue: No bugs found requiring RCA in this pass.
